item.title: Constant illegal parking in bus lane, 27th October
item.description:
Hello, I hope all is well. I just wanted to report constant vehicles parked in the bus lane on this road. Every day when I am on my home from work, there is traffic jams and buses having to terminate due to them not being able to get past as multiple cars are parked illegally in the bus lane. The signs clearly state that no parking is allowed in the bus lane before 7pm but I’m not sure if this is being enforced. With the temporary lights further up on green lanes/broomfield lane, this is causing severe and significant delays to everybody’s journey as well as a safety risk as motorcycles and bikes are weaving in and out of traffic, road rage is happening everyday and a usual 20 minute bus journey is taking upwards of an hour. I’d really appreciate if someone could look into this please.
Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Green Lanes, Southgate
Report on FixMyStreet
